🎥🎬: The Night Manager (2016)

Jonathan Pine is a former British soldier working as the night manager of a luxury hotel in Cairo. His quiet life takes a dangerous turn when he receives confidential information about an international arms operation connected to Richard Roper, a wealthy businessman secretly running a powerful weapons-trafficking network.

Recruited by British intelligence, Pine is tasked with infiltrating Roper’s inner circle and gathering evidence that could bring down his criminal empire. But earning Roper’s trust means entering a world of deception, corruption and extreme danger, where one wrong move could expose his true identity.

As Pine gets closer to the arms dealer, the mission becomes increasingly personal, forcing him to navigate shifting loyalties and deadly secrets. With lives at stake and powerful enemies watching, he must decide how far he is willing to go to bring Roper down.
